name: Herdr
description: Install Herdr and bridge its pane socket in from the Docker host

version.description: Select or enter a Herdr version to install

bridge.description: Bridge the host's HERDR_SOCKET_PATH Unix socket into the container over host.docker.internal, so hooks/plugins that report agent state can reach it. Needed on Docker Desktop/OrbStack-style setups, where the host's Unix socket file isn't reachable through a bind mount.

bridgePort.description: TCP port the host-side socat bridge listens on (must match the port used by the herdr-socket-bridge LaunchAgent on the host)
